blocks.label: code-parser watcher + v11/v12 bench
blocks.gist: The code-parser CLI generates a full JSONL snapshot of the codebase, while the watcher provides a stream of incremental updates for changed files rather than modifying a static JSON file in place.

blocks.label: pi-codemap jev + consolidation + decider
blocks.gist: Refactored v12.1 to replace custom Jev transport with pi's official registry, deleting 250 lines of credential and login code while preserving custom judgment logic.

blocks.label: typellm research + per-repo keys
blocks.gist: Established TypeLLM as a first-class provider alongside Jev, leveraging its DAG capabilities for decision trees and extended features like free-text and thinking traces.

blocks.label: routing phase 1/2 + virtual model
blocks.gist: Discovered and fixed a critical bug where codemap tools returned strings instead of arrays, causing 100% tool call failures and opaque errors to the model, then re-ran a clean 18-run evaluation to measure true performance benefits.

blocks.label: docs + PII audit
blocks.gist: Documented the codemap/auto routing mechanism in the README and scrubbed PII (username and local paths) from the pi-codemap repository.

blocks.label: infinite-chat brainstorm
blocks.gist: Brainstormed a 'topic memory' extension for pi that uses TypeLLM for topic classification and a side-car index to manage context without invalidating the KV cache.

blocks.label: morph divergent research + product tension
blocks.gist: Validated that reveal.js lacks a custom block model and relies on fragile HTML comments, confirming Morph's structured grammar approach is superior while identifying two minor patterns worth adopting.

blocks.label: morph plans + settings modal
blocks.gist: Evaluated @preact/signals-core against the CSMA runtime, concluding they are distinct layers where signals should be adopted for product-layer UI state while strictly excluding them from the zero-dependency Layer 0 core.

blocks.label: morph ship 007 + design skill port + outline search
blocks.gist: Shipped MorphEditor 007 and identified the depth-2 tool mangling root cause as fuzzy agent-file matching overriding explicit tool configurations.

blocks.label: morph export/android + sidebar polish
blocks.gist: Fixed the RTL implementation by correcting the mode conflation bug where explicit direction settings were being overridden by per-block auto-detection, ensuring the document direction now properly applies to prose blocks.

blocks.label: morph plan reviews + subagent fleet + sync gateway
blocks.gist: Item 14 is complete, implementing persistent undo/redo that survives app restarts via a consolidated history choke point, a ported Morph history module, and a serialization adapter with block-id remapping.

blocks.label: morph glm subagent impl + contracts error + diff bug
blocks.gist: TASK 1 (re1-small-moves) was merged to main after passing all review gates, and TASK 2 (re2-documents-export) is currently in progress with the worker having completed its file moves and initial test gates.

blocks.label: morph task-list comments + columns html
blocks.gist: Approved Plan 023 v2, adding reactions and cross-document bookmarks to the existing badge and menu tasks, and generated the five corresponding specification contracts.

blocks.label: morph calendar fix + sidebar markdown
blocks.gist: Decided to refactor the inline date picker to reuse the existing FormBar calendar UI, identifying that it lacks the '+ End date' range selection feature and a confirmation strip needed for inline editing.
